summary: @servicetitan/marketing-form 0.1.3 ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload
details: Version 0.1.3 of @servicetitan/marketing-form ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (`preinstall: node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases and uses `execFileSync` to run a sibling file, `math_init.js`, with cwd set to the package directory. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, `WV8StW` string-array rotator, `_0x`-style identifiers) whose behavior is opaque without executing it. The package's declared purpose is a small React marketing-form / async-lazy-dropdown helper, and its declared `dist/` content is a two-line re-export; the Bun download and obfuscated payload are unrelated to that purpose. Additionally, `package.json` declares `"files": ["dist", "src"]`, but the tarball root also contains `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` — the payload files are not part of the declared publish manifest, consistent with an unauthorized publish or maintainer-account compromise. Executing an obfuscated blob under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime at `npm install` time on any machine that installs this package constitutes install-time remote code execution against the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
